venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Yes! Ace of Spades strives to make our venue and live experiences inclusive and accessible. For more questions, or information not mentioned below, don't hesitate to get in touch with us at AceADA@livenation.com or our general inbox at AceOfSpades@livenation.com. The main entrance is accessible. An additional queuing lane is available for your convenience, please follow ADA Entrance signage at the front of the venue, or check in with any member of staff for assistance. All our restrooms include at least one accessible stall. The venue is General Admission. To inquire about accessible seating areas, please email AceADA@livenation.com. Our accessible seating area can reach capacity early, so we recommend contacting us as early as possible.

generalInfo.generalRule: All events are all ages unless otherwise noted. All attendees are required to purchase a full price ticket regardless of age. Please note there are NO refunds or exchanges unless an event is cancelled or postponed. Smoking is NOT permitted inside the building. PLEASE NOTE: We reserve the right to conduct security searches prior to entry and the right to refuse admission. Our security procedures may include the use of metal detection devices, pat downs, and bag searches. We utilize these safety measures during all of our events to make sure that all patrons, artists, and staff are safe and secure in our venue. We may also have Sacramento Police Department officers on site during our events to add even more security for our guests.

events.name: KATHY GRIFFIN: New Face, New Tour
events.info: Kathy Griffin is a two time Emmy and Grammy award winning comedian, a towering figure on television, on tour and in publishing. She is known globally with her universally recognized brand of pull no punches comedy. In 2019, Kathy completed her Laugh Your Head Off World Tour, which featured sold out performances across the globe including North America, Europe, Australia and Singapore. This worldwide exposure led to her first docucomedy feature film, Kathy Griffin: A Hell of a Story, which debuted in over 700 theaters nationwide on July 31, 2019. The film has been featured in numerous film festivals, receiving critical acclaim. A Hell of a Story is now available for digital download on Apple, Amazon, or wherever movies are sold around the world.
